author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** #16 landed memory + kafka + nats backends with compile-tests for the feature gates and trait conformance. Live integration tests (testcontainers-driven publish→subscribe round-trips against real Kafka + NATS brokers) deferred to keep the dispatch under the truncation threshold.

**Deliverables.**
- polaris-backend/tests/bus_kafka_integration.rs — testcontainers Kafka (apache/kafka or confluentinc image), publish + subscribe + bincode envelope round-trip + bounded backpressure.
- polaris-backend/tests/bus_nats_integration.rs — testcontainers NATS, same round-trip shape.
- Both #[cfg(feature = "bus-kafka")] / #[cfg(feature = "bus-nats")] gated.

**Done when.** Both integration tests run live against testcontainers and assert publish→subscribe equivalence + bounded backpressure behaviour.
